crescent_sweep.name: Crescent Sweep
crescent_sweep.description: A wide arcing slash that strikes every foe in a short cone ahead.

ember_lance.name: Ember Lance
ember_lance.description: A quick burning thrust that pierces every foe along a narrow line.

mending_gale.name: Mending Gale
mending_gale.description: A soothing wind that restores health and briefly sharpens your attacks.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Slip a few paces toward the cursor in a blur of shadow.
